result: Formal ablation used a 0.05 residual over deterministic guidance and a legacy reward with extra shaping terms; mature stable_V2 checkpoint lacks the paper attention-residual backbone.

The initial trust setting and its CPU ablation pilots were stopped after the paper-aligned tuned Full policy completed 120000 steps but failed all 10 deterministic frozen-policy episodes; the failed development result is retained.

Rejected. At 240000 steps the deterministic frozen policy achieved 0/10 strict coverage in both cases; mean closest approach was 243.240 m in Case1 and 686.753 m in Case2. Guided-rollout success was not counted as deployment success.
Rejected after multiple long-budget variants remained zero-hit under frozen deterministic deployment.

Separated the 1500-step physical horizon from the 4096-transition PPO buffer, fixed persistent alive masks, and tested both probability-consistent guide masking and the manuscript-literal mixture update; neither alone produced frozen-policy hits.

Tested source holds, PPO epoch 1, high-PN N=10, and guide weights 0.92/0.07/0.01. The guide itself became highly successful, but the frozen actor showed only transient closest-approach improvements and no reliable hits.

Swept initial trust, faster trust adaptation, max-gradient 0.1, and positive adaptive-KL initialization. Closest approach briefly reached about 63--77 m, then regressed without any held-out individual hits.

Corrected the training guide to use the same delayed/noisy target packet as the actor instead of privileged true target state. Guide-only screening selected N=10, hold1 and a 0.95/0.04/0.01 PN/probe/uniform mixture. Both short-window v20 and long-window v21 probability-masked controls failed through update20. Manuscript-literal long-window v22 improved early closest approach but remains zero-hit and is still running.

The isolated Case-3 pipeline completed 100 preregistered episodes: all targets were intercepted in 100/100, and every target group met the 0.5-s coordination threshold in 72/100. All raw data, code, audit records, and V10 figures were returned under Re383926/Case3.

Created an untouched-source clone of stable_V2, restored the verified Case-1/Case-2 residual-guidance chain, added paper-aligned trust, GRU, and capacity-matched attention-residual switches, and passed all 8 short smoke combinations. Three fixed seeds at 81920 steps per variant/case are running remotely; all 24 runs will feed frozen validation, paired 100-episode Monte Carlo tests, training diagnostics, and V10 figures.
